title: Resumable-upload tracker returning the first missing offset
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might expect next_offset to be the end of the highest recorded chunk. The contract is resumability: gaps must be filled first, so the offset is the first missing chunk even when later chunks already arrived out of order, which the gap case in the check proves.
